irina (api): quick question — are we favouring a single unified gateway or a delegated per-service routing layer for internal APIs? thinking about quotas, per-route dashboards, and rollouts UX.
ben (platform): leaning delegated routes (mini-gateways) for code ownership + faster rollouts. quotas and tracing can stay service-owned.
maria (product): curious about the console UX — will ops see >100 tiny routes? that's noisy for customers who want 'app-level' metrics.
sam (devex): big +1 to delegation for latency/cost optimizations, but we need aggregated views in the console (route groups). we should expose a grouping key.
irina (api): proposal: route delegation for edge routing decisions, but unified control-plane for quotas & telemetry aggregation. means runtime routing is local, but control plane emits canonical route ids.
b en (platform): spelling out tradeoffs:
- Delegated: faster local changes, canary per-service, fewer cross-team changes. but harder to enforce global quotas and consistent headers.
- Unified gateway: easier global policies, central quota enforcement, simpler mutating filters, but bottleneck and slower deploys.

nate (sre): reliability note — unified gateway is single blast radius. we saw that in the auth-proxy outage last year. per-service delegation with circuit-breakers in front reduces that risk.
sam (devex): telemetry implementation detail: if we have delegated routings, each mini-gateway should emit a canonical stanza: service.namespace.route_id, plus tags for rollout_tier and canary_percent. console can stitch with that.
irina (api): sample header we can standardize:
```
X-RW-Route: org:service:route_name
X-RW-Route-Tier: primary|canary|shadow
```
router-bot: note: new schema for X-RW-Route added to proto v2 (automated). :gear:
ben (platform): quotas: option A = central quota-checker call (sync) on request path; option B = token bucket per mini-gateway synced via control plane (async). A = strict, B = scalable. thoughts?
maria (product): prefer B if we can provide clear eventual-consistency signals in the UI (e.g., last-sync, allowed-burst). customers expect quota delta transparency.
nate (sre): for B we must add server-side enforcement backstop in the unified tier for critical limits (billing/cost cap).
sam (devex): rollout UX — we should support: 1) canary percent by route, 2) auto-fallback when error_rate > threshold, 3) quick rollback from console. Delegation requires the mini-gateways to accept remote rollout config.
irina (api): agreed. architecture sketch:
- control plane publishes rollout configs + route catalog
- mini-gateways subscribe via longpoll/webhook or service-mesh config
- telemetry exported with canonical route ids to tracing and per-route dashboards
- console shows aggregated + per-service views and a global search

ben (platform): operational checklist:
1) define route-id canonicalization rules
2) add X-RW-Route headers to all runtime proxies
3) implement per-gateway token-bucket with periodic sync
4) central backstop enforcer for billing caps
5) console: group-by service and global rollup

maria (product): can we mock the console flow? sam, can your team sketch a quick prototype?
sam (devex): yes, can do a prototype with grouped view + canary slider. need a small backend feed of the route catalog.
irina (api): one more: proto vs json for route catalog payloads. proto makes validation easy, json is friendlier for quick edits in the console. i'd vote proto on the wire + JSON editor in UI that roundtrips.
ben (platform): +1. proto v2 for schema; UI can produce JSON that the control plane compiles to proto.
nate (sre): add retention TTLs on telemetry: per-route index for 90 days, global aggregates for 365. keep logs for 30. will cost spike be acceptable?
maria (product): we can gate longer retention behind paid tiers.
irina (api): action items: irina to PR route-id spec, ben to prototype per-gateway token-bucket sync design, sam to wire mock console, nate to propose SLOs/retention numbers.
b en (platform): can we do a quick yay/nay poll by end of day? default = delegated routes + unified control-plane for quotas/telemetry/backstop.
sam (devex): :thumbsup:
maria (product): :thumbsup:
nate (sre): :thumbsup:
irina (api): :thumbsup: thanks all — i'll open the spec PR and tag this thread.
